title: Discharge
wikitext: If the [[Lightning Gun]] is used in Water, Slime, or Lava, the gun causes an explosion that heavily damages the player. This "discharge" consumes all [[Cells]] and inflicts cells x 35 damage. With 100 cells, that inflicts 3500 damage on anything that is within sight of the player. The radius is the damage (35 x cells), plus 40. Discharging can be an effective strategy if combined with [[Pentagram of Protection]]. ==Damage range== * 17 - 1750 to firing player * 35 - 3500 to others
